loopAnomalyCheck.rule: seam <= 95th percentile of other steps and <= 1.25*max seven nearby steps + 0.5

pictureContinuity.metric: mean absolute RGB difference at 135x240 (0-255 scale)

cameraSeam.method: Periodic Fritsch-Carlson (C1) interpolation of every camera channel; the mean orbit rate (45 deg/s) is removed before interpolation and restored after, so the orbit closes after exactly 360 degrees.

arcs.rule: count, reach and brightness grow with log(rotor speed) above 2 rev/s; each ends on a riser cheek at the picture's rotor angle; none lit in strobe pictures 390-405

effects.quietPictures: pictures 0-371 carry no effect object or light (all hidden)

events.rule: first visible picture = ceil(sampleFrame / 735); exposure closes at the picture time

rotor.note: Raw MORPH07 telemetry is nearly periodic (V1 audit: 27.000035 revolutions). The residual is disclosed, not corrected; frame 0 unwraps the previous cycle so the shutter never spins backwards.

qualityReview.reviewer: Codex, with prior independent native/phone review
qualityReview.samplingRationale: Completed workflow40160011102 tested14 native1080x1920 frames at32and64samples. MeanRGBdifferences~1.2–2.0/255;32preservesmaterial,arc,strobe,vaporandreturnclarityatphonesize.64addsminorgrainrefinementwithgreatercost. No repeated pilots.

measurements.classification: exact or bounded one-LSB numerical variation; no changed geometry accepted
